Name: Gedaliah, Son of Amariah
Summary: Gedaliah, son of Amariah, is named only in Zephaniah's genealogy (Zephaniah 1:1), as the grandfather of the prophet. He is not the Gedaliah appointed governor after Jerusalem's fall — that Gedaliah was son of Ahikam, a different man.
KeyStory: Gedaliah appears only in Zephaniah's genealogy, as the prophet's grandfather between Cushi and Amariah.
RelatedPeople: Zephaniah; Cushi, Father of Zephaniah; Amariah, Son of Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Two Gedaliahs, two different men — Scripture's genealogies reward careful reading. Never merge namesakes into one person.
